prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System advises; never autonomously dispatches. Aliases: Duty Detection Officer=Orion; Air Attack Supervisor=Redtail; Caldera Incident Command Portal=Emberhall; Horizon Ridge Drone Dock=Kestrel; Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine=Lantern; MesoWest Weather Fusion Node=Brindle; Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console=Marigold; VHF Radio Gateway Repeater=Badger. Smoke Classifier Module→Orion: confidence/growth/obscuration/Ridge Shadow Mask/warnings; degraded detections cannot justify commitment. North Lookout Camera Mast→Thermal Spot Snippet/bearings; South Lookout Camera Mast→bearings/Camera Cleaning Log; both→health. Brindle→Wind Shift Bulletin. Lantern fuses imagery/weather/fuels/reconnaissance; confidence/time-validity mandatory. Configurations signed/versioned; imagery grid-registered. Redtail approves reconnaissance/drops/conflicts. Delayed Confirmed Ignition State blocks dispatch. Airspace Restricted State requires route/altitude acceptance/Helitack Crew Leader confirmation. Drone Tasking Service avoids aviation-lanes; degraded-release needs County Emergency Liaison’s Drone Corridor Permit. Kestrel→readiness/health/recovery; maintenance controller→Battery Swap Ticket; Drone Pilot Operator confirms safety. Marigold validates Runway Release Note/Suppression Drop Receipt; blocks unapproved/unready releases. East Retardant Loading Pump→Retardant Batch Slip; variance recirculates. Tanker Base Manager coordinates West Retardant Loading Pump; inspection precedes availability. Emberhall audits Crew Staging Pin/provenance/assignments. Crewline Mobile Tablet rejects expired packages. Disconnected: encrypted timestamped queues; no irreversible releases. Require least-privilege/MFA, retention controls, single-fault resilience, supervised training/annual refresh. Deployment governance board includes operational leadership, maintenance, information security, detection/aviation/ground-crew/county representatives; seasonal approval reviews residual risk/staffing/baselines/prior corrective actions. Documented mission-scenario testing: Emberhall/Lantern/classifier. Acceptance: masts/Brindle availability/timing/data-quality; drone service/Kestrel seasonal field execution/abort/status stability; Marigold/pumps controls/faults/audits; Badger/tablet coverage/persistence/authentication/degraded-network. Redtail confirms evidence before seasonal aviation enablement. Tanker Base Manager reviews Runway Release

New part:
S239: Each after-action review shall reconstruct the timeline from system logs, user accounts, communications records, and maintenance notes without assigning blame to individual operators.
S240: Review facilitators shall document what was expected to happen, what actually happened, why differences occurred, and which corrective actions are necessary before the next readiness cycle.
S241: Corrective actions shall be entered into a controlled improvement backlog with assigned ownership, target completion dates, verification methods, and linkage to the originating event.
S242: Data stewardship shall define retention, access control, quality review, and disposition rules for operational records, sensor data, model outputs, configuration records, and user activity records.
S243: Operational data used for model evaluation shall be protected from unauthorized alteration and shall preserve enough context to support later engineering review and regulatory inquiry.
S244: Changes to the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine or Smoke Classifier Module shall be evaluated with representative seasonal data before deployment to confirm that detection performance improves without unacceptable increases in false alerts.
S245: Configuration changes to field equipment shall be versioned, reviewed, and tested in a nonoperational environment before being promoted into the seasonal baseline.
S246: At the end of each fire season, the governance board shall compare system performance, operational workload, maintenance burden, and user feedback against the acceptance criteria approved for that season.
S247: The resulting improvement plan shall define which procedures, training materials, interfaces, algorithms, and support arrangements will be revised before the next seasonal readiness campaign begins.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
